summary: Improved the mass-deletion review summary for a large number of flat files.
changelog: When the deletion guard pauses for many files sitting at the top level of a folder, the review now shows a preview of the first files and a 'N more' note instead of just a bare counter, so you can see what was removed without scrolling a hundreds-row list.
Files inside subfolders keep the folder grouping; individual rows are only listed when the number of missing files is small.
